components.name: Bulgor Base
instructions: Blend all ingredients in a baking or pie dish.

components.name: Cherry Layer
ingredients: Juice drained from 1 can (1 lb.) red sour pitted cherries
instructions: Blend cornstarch and sugar in a saucepan.
Stir in the drained cherry juice. Cook (stir constantly) until thickened.
Stir in lemon juice.
Layer the drained cherries over the Bulgor mixture.

components.name: Custard
instructions: Blend all ingredients.
Pour egg mixture over the cherry mixture.
Bake in a moderate oven, 350°F, for 1 hour, or until custard is set.

name: Bulgor Indian Pudding
instructions: Mix all ingredients in a 2-quart casserole.
Cover and bake in slow oven, 325°F, 45 minutes.
Remove cover and continue baking about 45 minutes.
Serve with whipped cream or ice cream.

name: Old-Fashioned Bulgor-Raisin Pudding
instructions: Combine all ingredients in a baking dish.
Cover and bake in moderate oven, 325°F, 45 minutes.
Remove cover, stir, and continue baking uncovered about 45 minutes or until browned.

name: Chocolate Bulgor Bavarian
instructions: Blend gelatin in a saucepan.
Blend water, cocoa, and sugar and add to gelatin mixture.
Stir in milk. Heat until gelatin and sugar dissolve. Stir frequently. Do not boil.
Remove from heat and add cooked Bulgor and vanilla.
Chill until thick but not firm.
Fold in the whipped heavy cream.
Turn into a mould which has been brushed with salad oil. Chill until firm.
Unmould and garnish, if you wish, with whipped cream and candied cherries.

name: Steamed Bulgor Fruit Pudding
instructions: Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Add eggs; beat until thick and creamy.
Stir in cooked Bulgor and vanilla.
Grind prunes, raisins, and apricots together. Stir into Bulgor mixture.
Add milk alternately with dry ingredients. Blend well after each addition.
Fill greased loaf pan or mould three-fourths full. Cover tightly.
Steam 2 hours. Serve with whipped cream.
